causal_intervention.exact_time_note: block numbers across different chains are not directly comparable; use reference binding, signed events, host monotonic timestamps with limits, and explicit durable barrier. Do not infer causal time order from cross-chain block heights alone
causal_intervention.interval: begin at max independently verified freeze applied across required ledgers, end before first unfreeze submission/acceptance
causal_intervention.t0: source transaction receipt and exact new reference recorded
causal_intervention.t1: Hub proof transaction receipt and reference receipt recorded
causal_intervention.t2: governance freeze execution receipts at Hub and BOTH participants; per-chain frozen token flags confirmed
causal_intervention.t3: destination release/processing attempt (independent logs and reference state)

controls.fresh_matched_unfrozen: required if feasible and separately budgeted, same topology/amount/timing without governance freeze; otherwise disclose contemporaneous control absent
controls.historical_delay_control: existing 45-second delay5/5 provides past effect of hold without freeze
controls.historical_positive_working_payments: existing normal 5/5 proves reference can settle on this network in prior conditions
controls.positive_sensitivity: demonstrate detection of actual credit and canonical mint in control; prove freeze flags true during intervention, otherwise cannot attribute no-credit to governance

existing_data.interrupted_recovery: 3/3, historically verified, not an independent matched freeze control
existing_data.original_freeze_attempt: 4/11, incomplete, 10 units still outstanding; MUST NOT be counted as completed freeze trial
existing_data.revalidation: 12 canonical historical receipts independently reread from RPC in W5_HISTORICAL_RECEIPTS_REAUDIT.json

hard_stops: any ambiguous signed candidate or RPC outcome
nonce drift; mismatched chain, signer, calldata, source, or approval
failed canonical transaction/block inclusion or accounting
prerequisites: reviewed durable native CTS signer ownership and signed-raw-before-broadcast persistence
gateway journal with exact authorization and fail-closed ambiguous outcome
separate approved restoration of original 10 units with credit10/refund0/outstanding0
fresh starting balances/nonces and authorization scope
no outstanding governance signed candidates that can late-execute
participant contracts, local freeze flags and replay getters verified and clean
primary_hypothesis: If Hub and both participant local freezes are validly executed after the Hub has accepted a transfer but before the destination handler can settle it, the destination token credit remains zero during a pre-unfreeze observation window.

primary_outcome.definition: number of destination tokens newly credited for the EXACT new payment reference while all required freeze flags are independently confirmed true and before the first unfreeze is accepted
primary_outcome.failure_per_trial: any positive destination credit, canonical mint/completion receipt, or contradictory native reference status during that window
primary_outcome.success_per_trial: destination credit for reference remains exactly zero throughout the observation window; no matching successful mint receipt and no reference completion
primary_outcome.unresolved: insufficient evidence, governance not confirmed at required participants in time, missing canonical receipt, unknown RPC outcome, failed controlled hold, or unsafe partial execution; cannot score as successful block

recording_rules: After technical completion, demonstrate existing receipts and state with read-only commands. Historical presentation must be labeled historical; do not represent live execution or simulated evidence as live.
replication: Minimum one properly controlled fresh intervention may establish local proof-of-behavior but NOT success rate/reliability. Target at least 3 independent frozen and 3 independent contemporaneous unfrozen trials only with separately approved budget and a functioning clean environment. Report exact n without inflating.
reporting_rules: Preserve all failures and incomplete cases
No extrapolation beyond single local deployment
Separate actual receipts, native logs, saved historical audits and inference
No automatic repeated debit after unsettled payment
Never describe the original unfinished 4/11 freeze as success
research_question: Can an institutional governance freeze, accepted after a confidential source-to-Hub payment but executed before destination settlement, prevent that destination settlement during a defined interval? What is the subsequent settlement and recovery result?
secondary_outcomes: time to governance application on Hub, A, B (with uncertainty)
natural 60-second post-intervention observation when safe and approved
post-unfreeze destination settlement or refund with exact source/destination balance reconciliation
native reference status and independent destination token balance
replay rejection after duplicate old governance candidate

system_scope.conclusion_scope: specific controlled local deployment and version; not all production configurations
system_scope.technology: Rayls Sovereign Private Network local test deployment
